name: Frequency-Modulated Edge-Aware Loss
definition: A loss term that uses a Difference of Gaussians (DoG) filter to create an edge-aware mask, focusing the optimization on specific frequency bands (low to high) to tune the shape parameter beta and improve high-frequency detail reconstruction.
summary: Frequency-Modulated Edge-Aware Loss uses a Difference of Gaussians filter to spatially weight errors by spectral content, prioritizing low-frequency structures early and high-frequency details later to improve reconstruction in Generalized Exponential Splatting.
